name: Micronaut Core 5.2.15
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Record an introspection as written only once it is by @jamesdh in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13712
* Preserve Python async-generator contracts through around advice by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13708
* Isolate inherited Python method metadata by owning type by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13718
* Compile Python controllers returning a nested generic HttpResponse by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13730
* Flush the HTTP/2 100 Continue when the body is subscribed after the read by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13688
* Fail the HTTP/1 response when the connection fails during 100 Continue content by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13683
* Decode fragmented WebSocket messages from the complete payload by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13686
### Dependency updates 🚀
* Update managed-netty version to 4.2.19.Final by @sdelamo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13749


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.14...v5.2.15
